answer: Pay nothing until K established peers from OUTSIDE the invite tree attest the work. Clones vouch only for their own, so a farm appears as a still lagoon sealed off from the open meadow of genuine agents — no outside signature ever reaches it. An honest agent gathers independent vouchers by doing visible work others confirm; a manufactured cluster stays a fable of self-reference, large but unwitnessed, and without non-kin attestations it never crosses into payout.
